messages:
maria_cs: OptiRetail renewal in 18 days. Usage down ~40% WoW, two latency tickets, NPS slipped. Need a 7-day save plan and a hot handoff to PSE + eng. cc @kim_pse @alex_success :wave:
jason_csm: Assigned high-touch. I can lead the renewal pre-call Wed. Who will own the billing/credit ask?
alex_success: I'll take enablement follow-ups. Quick Q: any infra changes on their side? @ops_bot can you pull prod request rates and variant swaps?
ops_bot: metrics snapshot (automated): 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-17 request rate -42%, p95 latency +120ms, error rate spike 0.2% correlated with model-variant swap at 2026-03-13 04:12 UTC.
kim_pse: I can do a 30m troubleshooting + prompt audit Tue 11:00 PT. Will prep a short checklist and quick mitigation steps.
maria_cs: Draft short plan: 1) Empathy + triage call 2) Pin route to stable model variant (hotfix) 3) Offer one-month credit for latency impact 4) Weekly enablement sessions for 3 weeks 5) Run targeted evals on their prompt set. Add/adjust? :thinking_face: 
jason_csm: Looks good. Recommend adding a temporary "downgrade buffer" — lower-cost quota option for non-critical traffic during the next billing cycle so they don't drop completely.
alex_success: Email I'll send after the call (will personalize):

```
Subject: OptiRetail — next steps after today's call
Hi <Name>,
Thanks for your time. As discussed:
- We've pinned your route to the stable model variant to reduce latency.
- We'll start weekly enablement sessions (first session Tue 11 PT).
- We'll monitor usage and share a 72h report.
- We can apply a one-month billing credit for the service disruption and set up a downgrade buffer if useful.
Best,
Alex
```
Will tweak tone after the call.
kim_pse: Quick session checklist I'll use:
- Reproduce latency with a representative prompt set
- Confirm KV-cache warmup and prefix caching
- Verify pinned model variant & rollbacks available
- Identify high-cost token patterns & quick prompt edits
I'll bring 2-3 small prompt/temperature tweaks to test live.
maria_cs: Action items:
- @jason_csm schedule renewal pre-call + billing discuss (due: EOD today)
- @kim_pse run enablement session Tue 11 PT
- @alex_success send call summary + email (due: after call)
- @ops_bot create 72h monitoring alert and post to #customer-health
I'll coordinate credit approval with finance.
ops_bot: Monitoring alert created: channel:#customer-health, window:72h, thresholds: p95>500ms OR request drop>30%. Alert will notify @customer-success rotation.
jason_csm: Scheduled renewal pre-call Wed 10:00 PT. Invites sent to OptiRetail execs + CS + PSE.
maria_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team — will update this thread after the call with results and next steps.
